macro_context.market_sentiment: Strongly bullish — S&P 500 (+1.46% to 7,365), Nasdaq (+2.02% to 25,839), and Dow (+1.24% to 49,911) all closed at record highs on May 6. Futures are extending the rally on May 7 amid hopes of a U.S.-Iran peace deal. AI earnings beats (SMCI +24.5%, AMD +17.77%, NVDA +5.5%) are powering broad tech enthusiasm.
macro_context.fed_outlook: FOMC held rates at 3.5%–3.75% on April 29 (8-4 split, most contentious since Oct 1992). Statement flagged elevated inflation partly from energy prices. Markets are pricing no cuts through at least end of 2026; one Trump-appointed dissenter (Miran) pushed for an immediate cut, signaling political pressure on the Fed.

A U.S.-brokered peace deal appears imminent (Iran expected to deliver 14-point response May 7), which is the primary catalyst for the current rally. Secondary risks: U.S. intervention in Venezuela, NATO-Greenland tensions, EU-China overcapacity conflict in EVs and semiconductors.
